[Thinking]
**Calculating distance from Phoenix to Florence**

The user wants to know the distance from Florence, Arizona, to Phoenix, Arizona, and they're asking in Portuguese. I need to mention that Florence is about 61 miles southeast of Phoenix, which translates to around 98 kilometers. The driving time is approximately 1 to 1.25 hours, depending on the route. For a simpler driving direction, US-60 and AZ-202 might be the best option. I should also recommend checking real-time maps for updates.
[/Thinking]

Florence (AZ) fica a cerca de 60–65 milhas de Phoenix (aprox. 97–105 km) por estrada — normalmente entre 1h e 1h15 de carro, dependendo do trânsito e da rota. Em linha reta são cerca de 50–55 milhas (80–90 km). Para tempo e rota exatos, verifique um app de mapas (Google Maps, Waze) com seu ponto de partida e horário.
